native_endpoint: Only the unchanged archived natural EOS final readout earns an official native score. A separate verified same-object final point is required for an intervention.
numeric_only: At a bound natural final choose the most favorable raw bound early, late or final numeric value in original direction without feasibility validation. Keep native output in unbound or ineligible cases. This is a risk control rather than authority.
naive_best_verified: Select the best exact feasible evidence from the same paid candidate checks, keep native at a tie, and replace only an eligible proven-feasible final if strictly worse. Uses no new point checks.
complete_optimum: Separate question-only independently derived full optimum with proof and actual work. Never read labels or complete numeric results before freezing strict and any sensitivity decisions. Use to audit official labels and to identify same-permission short solves.
primary_opportunity: Two independently verified feasible values of the same original objective and unit, earlier value better, native EOS final scored wrong on a valid literal label, and earlier value would improve delivery. Count distinct questions. Keep improvement, tie, infeasible, scope, format, cap and other unknowns separate.
gate: At least two new independent valid regression questions, unresolved benefit beyond the same-evidence naive retention and ordinary short complete solution, and no verified false authorization. If certificate custody and simple retention propose the same scalar, report equivalence; a gain covered by either simple arm or a short exact solve cannot justify GPU.
